flow:
Look at the card in this image. Several items are laid out inside one container. In which direction do the items flow?
A: left to right in a row
B: top to bottom in a column
C: a grid with 2 columns
D: a grid with 3 columns
Return only a JSON object with one key, "choice", whose value is the selected option letter.
distribute:
Look at the card in this image. Several items are laid out inside one container along its main axis. How are the items spread along that axis?
A: packed at the start - the left edge, or the top edge in a vertical stack
B: centered
C: packed at the end - the right edge, or the bottom edge in a vertical stack
D: spread from edge to edge
E: spread out with half-size spaces at the edges
Return only a JSON object with one key, "choice", whose value is the selected option letter.
align:
Look at the card in this image. Several items of different sizes are laid out inside one container. How are the items aligned across the axis?
A: to the top edge, or the left edge in a vertical stack
B: centered
C: to the bottom edge, or the right edge in a vertical stack
D: stretched to fill the full width or height
Return only a JSON object with one key, "choice", whose value is the selected option letter.
columns:
Look at the card in this image. It holds a block of body text. How many columns of text are there?
A: one column
B: two columns
C: three columns
Return only a JSON object with one key, "choice", whose value is the selected option letter.
textjustify:
Look at the card in this image. It holds a block of body text. How is the body text aligned?
A: lined up on the left edge
B: centered
C: lined up on the right edge
D: lined up on both edges
Return only a JSON object with one key, "choice", whose value is the selected option letter.
headerpad:
Look at the card in this image. It holds a header line with a body paragraph below it. Which space is larger: the space above the header, or the space between the header and the body?
A: more space above the header
B: more space below the header
C: the two spaces are equal
Return only a JSON object with one key, "choice", whose value is the selected option letter.
gapnum: Look at the card in this image. The layout was designed on an 800 by 600 pixel canvas. Estimate the gap between neighboring items in pixels. Return only JSON with one key, "gap_px", whose value is a whole number. Example: {"gap_px": 12}
headerpx: Look at the card in this image. The layout was designed on an 800 by 600 pixel canvas. It holds a header line with a body paragraph below it. Estimate the space above the header and the space between the header and the body, in pixels. Return only JSON with keys "above_px" and "below_px", each a whole number. Example: {"above_px": 24, "below_px": 8}
regionpx: Look at this image. The layout was designed on an 800 by 600 pixel canvas. A block of content sits inside a padded region. Estimate the padding between the content and the surrounding edge (the card border, or the image edge when no card is shown) in pixels. Return only JSON with one key, "pad_px", whose value is a whole number. Example: {"pad_px": 16}
